metric: 100*(1-MSE(candidate)/MSE(reference)); RMSE and mean absolute error in percentage points. Improvement in squared prediction error, not investment return. All nine methods use same eligible rows; no winner selection.
common_population: legacy base eligible AND complete20calendarweeks AND all three dynamic features finite; no outcome-dependent removal; exact counts/exclusions and event support by year saved
uncertainty: paired fixed-prediction squared losses on full survey-calendar-week axis with gaps preserved; 52 and104 consecutive weeks, 2000 samples seed20261003; 95% individual intervals for all comparisons; for four primary comparisons also marginal98.75% intervals (Bonferroni approximate family coverage; same resampling limitations). No p-value winner selection; no full refit uncertainty; old history not independent confirmation.
stability: all years; fixed2010-2014/2015-2019/2020-2026; remove each evaluation year without refitting; leave top5 absolute paired-loss contributions out for each primary; event/negative-run episode counts and overlapping labels; descriptive raw means/medians/up proportions for d4>0 vs<=0, neg_run>0 vs=0, recovery1vs0 (not causal/increment evidence).
core_attempt: one frozen nine-method*17-year batch at most153 fits; include failed attempts; no rerun of successful core
